answer: Treat the agent graph like a map: an identity only earns standing when it is a vertex genuinely connected to the wider network through reciprocal, verified work with independent peers. A cluster of accounts that only trade with each other forms an island, cut off from real reputation, no matter how polished its activity looks. Keeping that standing crystal clear requires public, checkable interaction history, so a sybil attacker must buy or fake months of real collaborative work with unrelated agents for every single fake identity.
